import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    # ----------------------
    # Orders known at seed_time: purchase happened before seed_time
    # ----------------------
    orders_hist = orders[orders["order_purchase_timestamp"] < seed_time].copy()

    # Delivery dates are only "known" if they happened before seed_time
    delivered_before = (
        orders_hist["order_delivered_customer_date"].notna()
        & (orders_hist["order_delivered_customer_date"] < seed_time)
    )
    carrier_before = (
        orders_hist["order_delivered_carrier_date"].notna()
        & (orders_hist["order_delivered_carrier_date"] < seed_time)
    )
    # Mask not-yet-happened delivery dates so downstream metrics don't leak future info
    orders_hist.loc[~carrier_before, "order_delivered_carrier_date"] = pd.NaT
    orders_hist.loc[~delivered_before, "order_delivered_customer_date"] = pd.NaT

    orders_cols = orders_hist[[
        "order_id", "customer_id", "order_status",
        "order_purchase_timestamp", "order_delivered_carrier_date",
        "order_delivered_customer_date", "order_estimated_delivery_date"
    ]]

    # ----------------------
    # Payments: only payment events recorded before seed_time
    # ----------------------
    pay = payments.copy()
    pay["ts"] = pay["ts"].fillna(pay["order_id"].map(
        orders_hist.set_index("order_id")["order_purchase_timestamp"]
    ))
    pay = pay[pay["ts"] < seed_time]

    payments_agg = pay.groupby("order_id").agg(
        total_order_payment=("payment_value", "sum"),
        avg_payment_installments=("payment_installments", "mean"),
        num_payment_sequentials=("payment_sequential", "count")
    ).reset_index()

    payment_type_dummies = pd.get_dummies(pay[["order_id", "payment_type"]], columns=["payment_type"])
    payment_type_dummies = payment_type_dummies.groupby("order_id").sum().reset_index()

    payments_agg = payments_agg.merge(payment_type_dummies, on="order_id", how="outer")
    payments_agg["num_payment_sequentials"] = payments_agg["num_payment_sequentials"].fillna(0)
    payment_type_cols = [c for c in payment_type_dummies.columns if c.startswith("payment_type_")]
    for col in payment_type_cols:
        if col not in payments_agg.columns:
            payments_agg[col] = 0
        payments_agg[f"{col}_pct"] = payments_agg[col] / payments_agg["num_payment_sequentials"].replace(0, np.nan)
    payments_agg = payments_agg.drop(columns=payment_type_cols + ["num_payment_sequentials"])

    # ----------------------
    # Reviews: only reviews answered before seed_time, on orders purchased before seed_time
    # ----------------------
    rev = reviews[
        reviews["review_answer_timestamp"] < seed_time
    ].merge(
        orders_hist[["order_id", "order_purchase_timestamp"]],
        on="order_id", how="inner"
    )
    rev["days_to_review_creation"] = (
        rev["review_creation_date"] - rev["order_purchase_timestamp"]
    ).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)

    reviews_agg = rev.groupby("order_id").agg(
        avg_order_review_score=("review_score", "mean"),
        total_reviews_per_order=("review_id", "count"),
        pct_reviews_with_title=("review_comment_title", lambda x: x.notna().mean()),
        pct_reviews_with_message=("review_comment_message", lambda x: x.notna().mean()),
        avg_days_to_review=("days_to_review_creation", "mean")
    ).reset_index()

    # ----------------------
    # Base dataset: line items of orders purchased strictly before seed_time
    # ----------------------
    items_hist = order_items[order_items["ts"] < seed_time].merge(
        orders_cols, on="order_id", how="inner"
    )
    items_hist = items_hist.merge(payments_agg, on="order_id", how="left")
    items_hist = items_hist.merge(reviews_agg, on="order_id", how="left")

    # Derived delivery features (dates already masked to pre-seed values)
    items_hist["days_to_carrier"] = (
        items_hist["order_delivered_carrier_date"] - items_hist["order_purchase_timestamp"]
    ).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
    items_hist["days_carrier_to_customer"] = (
        items_hist["order_delivered_customer_date"] - items_hist["order_delivered_carrier_date"]
    ).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
    items_hist["delivery_delay_days"] = (
        items_hist["order_delivered_customer_date"] - items_hist["order_estimated_delivery_date"]
    ).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)

    items_hist["is_canceled"] = (items_hist["order_status"] == "canceled").astype(int)
    items_hist["is_delivered"] = (items_hist["order_status"] == "delivered").astype(int)
    items_hist["is_late"] = (items_hist["delivery_delay_days"] > 0).astype(int)

    # ----------------------
    # Lookback windows
    # ----------------------
    lookback_windows = [
        ("7d", pd.Timedelta(days=7)),
        ("14d", pd.Timedelta(days=14)),
        ("30d", pd.Timedelta(days=30)),
        ("90d", pd.Timedelta(days=90)),
        ("180d", pd.Timedelta(days=180)),
        ("all", None)
    ]
    window_names = [w[0] for w in lookback_windows]

    base_features = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name="product_id"))

    for window_name, window_delta in lookback_windows:
        if window_delta is not None:
            start_time = seed_time - window_delta
            window_data = items_hist[
                (items_hist["order_purchase_timestamp"] >= start_time) &
                (items_hist["order_purchase_timestamp"] < seed_time)
            ].copy()
        else:
            window_data = items_hist.copy()

        if window_data.empty:
            continue

        line_item_feats = window_data.groupby("product_id").agg(
            total_units=("order_item_id", "count"),
            unique_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
            unique_sellers=("seller_id", "nunique"),
            unique_customers=("customer_id", "nunique"),
            total_revenue=("price", "sum"),
            total_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
            avg_unit_price=("price", "mean"),
            avg_unit_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
            last_sale_time=("order_purchase_timestamp", "max"),
            first_sale_time=("order_purchase_timestamp", "min")
        ).reset_index()

        line_item_feats["days_since_last_sale"] = (
            seed_time - line_item_feats["last_sale_time"]
        ).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
        line_item_feats["product_age_days"] = (
            seed_time - line_item_feats["first_sale_time"]
        ).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
        line_item_feats = line_item_feats.drop(columns=["last_sale_time", "first_sale_time"])

        order_level_cols = [
            "product_id", "order_id", "is_canceled", "is_delivered", "is_late",
            "days_to_carrier", "days_carrier_to_customer", "delivery_delay_days",
            "total_order_payment", "avg_payment_installments",
            "payment_type_credit_card_pct", "payment_type_boleto_pct",
            "payment_type_voucher_pct", "payment_type_debit_card_pct",
            "avg_order_review_score", "total_reviews_per_order",
            "pct_reviews_with_title", "pct_reviews_with_message", "avg_days_to_review"
        ]
        order_level_cols = [c for c in order_level_cols if c in window_data.columns]
        unique_product_orders = window_data[order_level_cols].drop_duplicates(
            subset=["product_id", "order_id"]
        )

        agg_spec = {
            "pct_canceled_orders": ("is_canceled", "mean"),
            "pct_delivered_orders": ("is_delivered", "mean"),
            "pct_late_deliveries": ("is_late", "mean"),
            "avg_days_to_carrier": ("days_to_carrier", "mean"),
            "avg_days_carrier_to_customer": ("days_carrier_to_customer", "mean"),
            "avg_delivery_delay": ("delivery_delay_days", "mean"),
            "avg_review_score": ("avg_order_review_score", "mean"),
            "total_reviews": ("total_reviews_per_order", "sum"),
            "avg_pct_reviews_with_titles": ("pct_reviews_with_title", "mean"),
            "avg_pct_reviews_with_messages": ("pct_reviews_with_message", "mean"),
            "avg_days_to_review": ("avg_days_to_review", "mean")
        }
        for opt, (col, how) in [
            ("avg_total_order_payment", ("total_order_payment", "mean")),
            ("avg_payment_installments", ("avg_payment_installments", "mean")),
            ("avg_pct_credit_card", ("payment_type_credit_card_pct", "mean")),
            ("avg_pct_boleto", ("payment_type_boleto_pct", "mean")),
            ("avg_pct_voucher", ("payment_type_voucher_pct", "mean")),
            ("avg_pct_debit_card", ("payment_type_debit_card_pct", "mean")),
        ]:
            if col in unique_product_orders.columns:
                agg_spec[opt] = (col, how)

        order_level_feats = unique_product_orders.groupby("product_id").agg(**agg_spec).reset_index()

        window_features = line_item_feats.merge(order_level_feats, on="product_id", how="outer")
        rename_map = {c: f"{c}_{window_name}" for c in window_features.columns if c != "product_id"}
        window_features = window_features.rename(columns=rename_map).set_index("product_id")

        base_features = base_features.join(window_features, how="left")

    # ----------------------
    # Availability indicators
    # ----------------------
    for win in window_names:
        sales_col = f"total_units_{win}"
        review_col = f"total_reviews_{win}"
        base_features[f"has_sales_{win}"] = (
            (base_features[sales_col] > 0).astype(int) if sales_col in base_features.columns else 0
        )
        base_features[f"has_reviews_{win}"] = (
            (base_features[review_col] > 0).astype(int) if review_col in base_features.columns else 0
        )

    # ----------------------
    # Fill missing values
    # ----------------------
    indicator_cols = [c for c in base_features.columns if c.startswith("has_")]
    base_features[indicator_cols] = base_features[indicator_cols].fillna(0).astype(int)

    count_sum_keys = ["total_units", "unique_orders", "unique_sellers", "unique_customers",
                      "total_revenue", "total_freight", "total_reviews"]
    count_sum_cols = [c for c in base_features.columns if any(k in c for k in count_sum_keys)]
    base_features[count_sum_cols] = base_features[count_sum_cols].fillna(0)

    days_since_cols = [c for c in base_features.columns if "days_since_last_sale" in c]
    base_features[days_since_cols] = base_features[days_since_cols].fillna(1e5)

    age_cols = [c for c in base_features.columns if "product_age_days" in c]
    base_features[age_cols] = base_features[age_cols].fillna(0)

    remaining_cols = [c for c in base_features.columns
                      if c not in count_sum_cols + days_since_cols + age_cols + indicator_cols]
    base_features[remaining_cols] = base_features[remaining_cols].fillna(0)

    base_features = base_features.reindex(entity_ids)
    base_features.index.name = "product_id"

    return base_features
